description: Configure a deadline-reminder mail PER CONTRACT TYPE: a template (subject, body) with a recipient list and how many days ahead to remind. preview_contract_deadline_mails then shows the due reminders (draft-first; nothing is sent automatically). Required: contract_type. Optional (a passed field replaces, an omitted one keeps): subject, body (both support placeholders {{vertrag}} {{gegenpartei}} {{vertragsart}} {{stichtag}} {{art}} {{titel}} {{tage}}), recipients (array or comma list), lead_days (0-365, default 30), active (default true).

contract_type.description: Contract type this reminder template applies to, e.g. rental

lead_days.description: Days before the deadline to remind, 0-365 (default 30)

recipients.description: Recipient e-mail addresses of the reminder

name: set_contract_deadline_mail
